evidence.what: multiple marked police vehicles blocking intersection
officers and civilians standing in roadway around vehicles
white box truck and SUVs stopped in center of intersection

verdict.summary: Heavy police activity blocking intersection, expect full closure and use alternate route.
verdict.details: Aerial view of residential intersection fully blocked by seven-plus marked police vehicles and civilian cars. Officers and several civilians stand in roadway around a white box truck and SUVs. Trees and houses surround scene. No fire, ambulance, or tow visible.
